## Limestone Pie — G4 *Friendship Is Magic*

**Who she is:** Pinkie Pie’s **eldest sister** and the hot-tempered, fiercely protective manager of the Pie family rock farm. She is especially possessive of its sacred **Holder’s Boulder**. Recognize her by her slate-lavender coat, straight silver-gray mane and tail, yellow-green eyes, permanent scowl, and cutie mark of **a lime slice and two stones**. [Character and appearance](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Limestone_Pie_and_Marble_Pie)

**Name and nicknames:** She appeared **unnamed as a filly** in *The Cutie Mark Chronicles*. G. M. Berrow named her in the licensed 2013 chapter book *Pinkie Pie and the Rockin’ Ponypalooza Party!*; Berrow explained that **Marble, Limestone, Pinkie** gives the initials **MLP**. Pinkie calls her **“Captain Grumpy”** in *Hearthbreakers* and **“Limey”** in the chapter book. These are nicknames, not different ponies. [Berrow interview](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2015/08/bronycon-coverage-interview-with-gm.html) · [Book](https://books.google.com/books/about/My_Little_Pony_Pinkie_Pie_and_the_Rockin.html?id=UcCoyayRmRsC) · [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Hearthbreakers)

**Speaking and appearances:** Silent in the season-one flashback; a family-photo appearance in *Pinkie Pride*. She speaks prominently in **“Hearthbreakers”** (season 5), appears at Maud’s graduation in **“Rock Solid Friendship”** (season 7), and gives Pinkie a surprisingly perceptive **geode analogy** about Maud’s boyfriend Mudbriar in **“The Maud Couple”** (season 8). Also appears in *Best Gift Ever*, the *The Last Problem* finale montage, and IDW comics. **English voice: Ingrid Nilson**, who also voices Maud and Marble. [Episode dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Maud_Couple) · [Voice cast](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt4534330/fullcredits/)

**Show still — *Hearthbreakers*:** Limestone with Marble; a TV screencap, not original fan art. Studio artwork; mirrored by Manebooru’s `booruimporter` (original booru uploader unidentified).
